citation.title: Generative Lattice Units with 3D Diffusion for Inverse Design: GLU3D
citation.authors: Yayati Jadhav, Joeseph Berthel, Chunshan Hu, Rahul P. Panat, Jack Beuth, Amir Barati Farimani
citation.venue: Advanced Functional Materials 34(41) (2024) 2404165 (Wiley; published online 2024-06-06, issue dated October 2024, per Crossref); hybrid open access, CC BY-NC 4.0, per Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar
citation.version_coded: none: only the abstract was read (pool record from OpenAlex). The version of record could not be retrieved by script

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: Not coded (no accessible full text). Abstract: a 3D diffusion model generates lattice unit cells for target stiffness, said to speed up design and to beat simple-cubic and BCC cells in energy absorption and compression load at lower density.

Free to read in a browser: yes, per OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar (CC BY-NC hybrid open access), so a human verifier can open it on Wiley. Pointers from the abstract for the verifier: the stated comparators are standard unit cells (simple cubic and body-centred cubic), not a classical optimizer, and the design-speed claim is qualitative (FE simulation and expert input described as costly). At full text, check for a TO or homogenization-based optimization comparator; without one, FT-NOBASELINE (no classical optimizer run, timed or cited) or FT-SCOPE (§3.1 admits architected-material inverse design only with a TO or homogenization comparator) would apply. Code: the public repository github.com/BaratiLab/GLU3D-Generative-Lattice-Units-with-3D-Diffusion exists (GitHub API 2026-09-24: created 2023-10-31, last push 2024-07-31, no licence declared); it was found by web search, not from the article. Duplicate check: no other pool record or prefill of this study (P02135 by the same first author is a different study). No author named Jun Wang. Screening code was I-UNCLEAR.
